title: What is a good NPS score? Benchmarking & improvement tips

facts.fact: AskNicely's blog gives a benchmark NPS of approximately 60 for Technology & SaaS.
AskNicely's blog gives a benchmark NPS of approximately 50 for Marketing, advertising & consulting.
AskNicely's blog gives a benchmark NPS of approximately 42 for Retail & eCommerce.
AskNicely's customer story says Sangoma attributes its 29-point increase in NPS score to systemic improvements driven by customer feedback.
facts.quote: They attribute their 29-point increase in NPS score to these systemic improvements.
